en: First Collection, Chapter on the Leaf Please note that "Littavagga" appears to be a typographical error for "Pattavagga" (the Chapter on Leaves). Thus, the correct title is: The Jātaka: First Collection, Chapter on Leaves.
10. The Jātaka of the Unpleasant in the Form of the Pleasant “The unpleasant as the form of the pleasant,
the unlovely as the form of the lovely;”
Thus ends the tenth Jātaka, the Asātarūpa-jātaka.
The Tenth Chapter: The Chapter on Litta.
Gilāna, Makkha, Kutūhala, Mātuka, and Kassā.
And by the Sage, the supreme attainment of impermanence was reached;
the most wise Dhanapāliva-ra attained seventeen hundred and sixty [verses].
